BrochureContent.Content:
REA Stokes Quirke are delighted to bring this well presented 3-bedroom semi-detached residence to the market, ideally situated on College Avenue, Clonmel. This well-maintained house offers bright, spacious and well-proportioned accommodation, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, families or those looking to downsize while remaining close to the town centre. The property benefits from all mains services, double glazed PVC windows, and a C BER rating, ensuring comfortable and efficient day-to-day living. Internally, the accommodation has been carefully maintained and is ready for immediate occupation, allowing the successful purchaser to move in with minimal work required. Occupying a highly convenient residential location, the property is within walking distance of Clonmel town centre, schools, shops, sporting facilities, public transport, and a wide range of local amenities, offering an excellent balance of convenience and comfortable living. Early viewing is advised.


Accommodation

Entrance Hall
1.85m x 3.54m Timber flooring with a feature carpet staircase.

Bathroom
1.85m x 2.76m Tiled flooring, W.C, W.H.B , Bath and Shower.

Living Room
3.16m x 4.03m Timber flooring, stone surround fireplace and a window overlooking the front.

Kitchen
4.26m x 2.27m Timber flooring with units at eye and floor level along with a door to the rear garden.

First Floor

Landing
2.32m x 2.13m Carpet flooring

Bedroom 1
4.11m x 2.26m Timber flooring with a built in wardrobe and a window overlooking the front.

Bedroom 2
2.80m x 3.69m Timber flooring with windows overlooking the rear garden.

Bedroom 3
2.35m x 2.80m Timber flooring with windows overlooking the rear garden.


Outside

Ample street parking to the front along with a quaint rear garden and patio area.

3-bedroom semi-detached residence in very good decorative order throughout.
Bright and spacious accommodation ready for immediate occupation.
Excellent location within walking distance of Clonmel town centre and local amenities.
Gas heating with all mains connections 
Clonmel offers a full range of amenities including shops, schools, leisure facilities and public transport, all within easy reach of College Avenue.
Located on College avenue your within walking distance of all local amenities.
